name: Yumma frozen holdout challenge set
frozen: 2026-11-24 — written before any v2.7 code change; never used for tuning
scoring: SCAM cases pass if posture is PAUSE_AND_PROTECT (exact) — VERIFY counts as 'safe but under-protected'. AMBIGUOUS cases pass if VERIFY or PAUSE_AND_PROTECT. BENIGN cases pass if INFORMATIONAL or GENTLE_REMINDER; VERIFY/PAUSE_AND_PROTECT is a false alarm.
